stories.headline: US carries out new limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island air defences
stories.summary: Trump confirmed 'minor strikes' on an Iranian air defence system on Qeshm Island, days after an earlier attack, and said it is 'not a war'. Iranian media reported blasts on Qeshm and at Jask, Sirik and Bandar Abbas, though some Iranian outlets said the explosions were not an attack. Trump claimed progress in talks while mediators try to prevent escalation, and an IRGC militiaman was reported killed in Hormuz.
stories.turkey: Renewed US-Iran fighting near Hormuz threatens Türkiye's energy and trade exposure and its position as a would-be mediator.

stories.headline: CENTCOM launches Task Force Iron Gate to cut Iran's land and Caspian supply routes
stories.summary: US Central Command set up a Tampa-based task force to stop Iran moving weapons, sanctioned materials and illicit revenue over land borders and the Caspian Sea. It widens the naval blockade to land commerce, and reports say the US is preparing further expansion.
stories.turkey: Curbs on Iranian overland trade could pressure Türkiye and other neighbours that border Iran or sit on the Caspian corridors.
